## Engineering Solutions & Architectures
1. E-Commerce & Online Stores (https://niraj.online/solutions/ecommerce-development): Custom Next.js storefronts with Razorpay/Stripe checkout and automated WhatsApp order dispatch. Zero recurring platform subscription fees.
2. Healthcare & Medical Portals (https://niraj.online/solutions/healthcare-medical-portals): Fast, mobile-first websites for doctors, clinics, and diagnostic centers with WhatsApp appointment booking and OPD queue tracking. Compliant with DPDP Act 2023 principles and NMC medical ethics.
3. AI Chatbots & Workflow Automation (https://niraj.online/solutions/ai-chatbots-automation): Conversational AI assistants and RAG pipelines trained on private clinic SOPs and product catalogs with source citations and air-gapped local LLM options.
4. Portfolio & Personal Branding (https://niraj.online/solutions/portfolio-personal-branding-websites): Editorial, high-speed personal branding platforms for doctors, architects, photographers, and independent founders.
5. Nonprofit & Community NGO Platforms (https://niraj.online/solutions/nonprofit-community-websites): High-trust donation websites with UPI/Razorpay integration, 80G tax receipt data collection, and volunteer intake workflows.
